bullets: You will own the product strategy spanning enterprise wallets, custody, treasury infrastructure, access to onchain financial products from money at rest.
For our enterprise customers, that means solving the hard operational problems behind holding money onchain: secure wallet infrastructure, permissions and policies, custody…
It also means making onchain money radically easier to hold, control, move, and put to work for everyone who uses the OMS.
Your goal is to make Polygon the best place for global money to live—and the easiest place to decide what happens to that money next.
